response.sql:
WITH group_stats AS (
  SELECT
    s.zoneregistry AS site_code,
    s.insurstat AS insurance_status,
    AVG(sp.remaingb) AS avg_remaining_storage,
    AVG(sp.proccpu - sp.procgpu) AS avg_cpu_gpu_gap
  FROM scanprocessing sp
  INNER JOIN sites s ON sp.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
  GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.insurstat
),
overall_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_remaining_storage) AS mean_value
  FROM group_stats
)
SELECT
  g.site_code,
  g.insurance_status,
  g.avg_remaining_storage,
  g.avg_cpu_gpu_gap,
  g.avg_remaining_storage / o.mean_value AS storage_ratio
FROM group_stats g
CROSS JOIN overall_mean o
WHERE o.mean_value IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY storage_ratio DESC NULLS LAST, g.site_code
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: A secondary sort by site_code is applied for deterministic ordering of ties. The instruction specifies only the primary sort (storage_ratio DESC NULLS LAST), leaving tie-breaking undefined.

alternatives.interpretation: Omit the secondary sort key and sort only by storage_ratio DESC NULLS LAST, leaving results with equal ratios in database-dependent order.
